title: Nucleotide metabolic rewiring enables NLRP3 inflammasome hyperactivation in obesity | Science
content: Obesity is a major disease risk factor due to obesity-associated hyperinflammation. We found that obesity induced Nod-like receptor pyrin domain–containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome hyperactivation and excessive interleukin (IL)–1β production in macrophages ...
